promised.summary: Asian Paints delivers consistent domestic decorative volume growth and maintains gross margin discipline, with gradual scaling in home décor adjacencies.

promises.target: High single-digit domestic decorative volume growth
promises.quote: We expect domestic decorative volumes to track in the 8 to 10 percent corridor supported by early festive restocking.
promises.actual: Delivered 8.5% volume growth in domestic decorative segment in Q2 FY27.

promises.quote: With benign crude derivatives and titanium dioxide prices, our gross margin guidance remains firmly within the 43 to 44 percent range.
promises.actual: Achieved 43.6% gross margin in Q1 FY27 and 43.4% in Q2 FY27.

promises.target: Achieve 8-10% revenue contribution from Home Décor
promises.quote: Our transition from share of surface to share of space targets 8 to 10 percent of retail revenue from kitchens, bath, and furnishings.
promises.actual: Current home décor contribution stands at 6.8%, tracking slightly behind the 8% target.

promises.target: 25%+ revenue growth in lighting and UPVC windows
promises.quote: Both White Teak and Weatherseal are seeing strong brand synergies through our Beautiful Homes network, compounding at over 25 percent.
promises.actual: White Teak and Weatherseal grew 28% YoY in H1 FY27 through 600+ Beautiful Homes stores.

snapshot.description: Asian Paints is India's preeminent paints and coatings leader holding over 50% domestic decorative market share, bolstered by 160,000+ direct dealer touchpoints and proprietary tinting machines.

cash.note: Unrivalled direct-to-dealer network with 3-4 daily supply drop runs eliminates distributor markups and maximizes cash flow.

targets.guidance: Commission 30% capacity expansion across Khandala and Mysuru plants
Expand experiential Home Décor stores to 1,000 outlets by FY27

bull_points: Unassailable distribution moat with tinting machines embedded in 160,000+ retail stores.
Stable raw material prices (crude derivatives and TiO2) safeguard gross profit margins.
High return on invested capital (>34%) and debt-free fortress balance sheet.
bear_points: Entry of deep-pocketed Grasim (Birla Opus) creating dealer rebate and discounting price competition.
Extended monsoon cycles delaying festive exterior repainting projects.
